description:
Synopsis
In a world where old legends have been forgotten, the hunter Victoria works in the shadows, eliminating the last remnants of the vampire bloodlines.
One night, she receives a new mission: infiltrate a secluded Victorian mansion deep in the woods and rescue a young woman named Eleanor, kidnapped by an ancient vampire who has awakened once more. Upon arrival, Victoria discovers the mansion is far more than a simple refuge — it is a sanctuary of darkness, infested with vampires, ghouls, and bloodthirsty creatures.
Eleanor, weakened but determined, manages to escape her cell and crosses paths with Victoria, forming a fragile and uneasy alliance. Together, they must survive, push through decaying corridors, solve ancient mechanisms, and confront the horrors lurking in every corner.
Explore oppressive environments, solve environmental puzzles, and carefully manage your resources: ammunition is scarce, light is vital, and every encounter matters. Combine a variety of weapons and tools to adapt to unpredictable enemies, or team up in local split-screen co-op to face the horror together.

Survive. Cooperate. Uncover the truth.
Key Features
Modernized Classic Survival Horror
Explore dark, oppressive environments where danger may hide around every corner. Constant tension and vulnerability are at the heart of the experience.
Third-Person Combat
Face grotesque creatures using a variety of weapons and tools. Every enemy encounter demands strategy, positioning, and steady nerves.
Character-Driven Narrative
A story centered on the evolving relationship between its protagonists, where choices, the past, and emotional tension grow alongside the danger.
Local Split-Screen Co-op
Experience the full journey with another player. Coordinate strategies, share resources, and face the horror as a team.
Environment-Driven Puzzles
Solve environmental and mechanical puzzles to progress. Observation, logic, and exploration are essential.
Resource Management
Ammunition is limited, healing is scarce, and every item counts. Smart inventory management can mean the difference between life and death.
short_description: You play as Victoria, a vampire hunter haunted by her past, and Eleanor, a young woman trapped in a nightmare that has only just begun. Together, they must endure grotesque creatures, hidden traps, and a presence that seems to know them better than they realize.
